decisions.reason: As a machinery line that builds directly on our engineering, plant-process and service knowledge, it fits our absorptive capacity well and can be improved through in-house R&D, although its recent launch and model complexity still leave some withdrawal risk if demand stays thin.

This software is close to our installed base of controls, planning and lifecycle support, so we can interpret customer feedback quickly and refine it with our existing capabilities, making continuation more likely than withdrawal.
